metas.name: Mean Girls
metas.description: A quintessential teen comedy that aligns perfectly with your enjoyment of Clueless and 10 Things I Hate About You.

metas.name: The Mummy
metas.description: A high-octane adventure with plenty of humor and charm, perfect if you liked Jumanji and Dungeons & Dragons.

metas.name: Guardians of the Galaxy
metas.description: Shares the colorful, music-driven, and comedic tone of Thor: Ragnarok and your interest in fun sci-fi.

metas.name: Game Night
metas.description: A fast-paced mystery comedy that fits right in with the cleverness of Knives Out and the wit of The Nice Guys.

metas.name: Stardust
metas.description: A whimsical fantasy adventure with a romantic core, similar in tone to Practical Magic and Fantastic Beasts.

metas.name: Kiss Kiss Bang Bang
metas.description: Directed by Shane Black, this shares the sharp banter and comedic crime-solving vibe of The Nice Guys.

metas.name: Legally Blonde

metas.name: Free Guy

metas.name: Knives Out

metas.name: The Princess Bride

metas.name: Hot Fuzz

metas.name: 21 Jump Street

metas.name: Palm Springs

metas.name: About Time

metas.name: Easy A

metas.name: The Mask

metas.name: Kingsman: The Secret Service

metas.name: Ocean's Eleven
metas.description: A smooth, cool, and comedic heist film that fans of Get Shorty and lighthearted crime capers will love.

metas.name: Popstar: Never Stop Never Stopping

metas.name: Glass Onion: A Knives Out Mystery

metas.name: Paddington 2
metas.description: The ultimate feel-good movie; it is purely uplifting, funny, and provides the ultimate cinema comfort.

metas.name: Everything Everywhere All At Once
metas.description: A wild, imaginative adventure that blends multiverse action and comedy with a huge amount of heart.

metas.name: Death at a Funeral
metas.description: A chaotic and hilarious British ensemble comedy that fits the 'fun-to-watch' relaxing vibe perfectly.

metas.name: Spy
metas.description: A hilarious action-comedy that is lighthearted, consistently funny, and features great comedic performances.

metas.name: A Knight's Tale
metas.description: A fun, anachronistic medieval adventure that captures the same adventurous spirit as Dungeons & Dragons.

metas.name: Scott Pilgrim vs. the World
metas.description: Visually inventive and funny, matching the unique energy of Thor: Ragnarok and animated comedies.

metas.name: Zombieland

metas.name: Enchanted
metas.description: A delightful blend of fantasy, comedy, and romance that matches the fish-out-of-water fun of Thor and Jumanji.

metas.name: The Birdcage

metas.name: Big Trouble in Little China
metas.description: A cult-classic fantasy adventure with a great sense of humor, similar in tone to Dungeons & Dragons.

metas.name: Pitch Perfect

metas.name: Midnight in Paris

metas.name: Galaxy Quest

metas.name: How to Train Your Dragon

metas.name: Bring It On

metas.name: Mystery Men

metas.name: The Unbearable Weight of Massive Talent
